prompt: Which pair of C=O IR frequencies is correct for a normal ketone vs an α,β-unsaturated ketone?

options.label: Normal ketone ~1715; conjugated enone ~1680 (conjugation lowers C=O frequency)
Normal ketone ~1680; conjugated enone ~1715 (conjugation raises C=O frequency)
Both at ~1715 (conjugation changes intensity but not frequency)
Both at ~1735 (ketones all fall near the standard C=O frequency)

explanation: Conjugation of C=O with an adjacent C=C or aryl delocalizes the π bond → lowers C=O bond order → lower frequency by ~30 cm⁻¹. Normal ketone ~1715; α,β-unsaturated ~1680; aryl ketone ~1685. Same shift happens with esters (1735 → 1715 if conjugated).
